title: Record cost, author model and a 7-day outcome per PR in krn ledger
body:
Outcome: `bin/krn ledger` rows carry dollars, lead/subagent split, author role and model, and a 7-day outcome (reverted or same lines changed again) per merged PR; one PR is attributed only the turns of its slice.
Why: .krn/runs/strategy-review/report.md: the metric is cost per accepted change, but the ledger lacks dollars, model and outcome, and attributes 271M cache-read tokens to #474 (a whole session).
Proof: ledger output for the last 30 PRs with no PR above the per-slice p99, recorded under .krn/runs/.
Scope: this repository.
